info.title: Smart Helpdesk API
info.description:
Smart Helpdesk REST API. All endpoints live under `/v1` on the API host.

- Authentication: the SPA uses the Sanctum session cookie (`GET /sanctum/csrf-cookie` first, then send
  `X-XSRF-TOKEN`); API clients use bearer tokens.
- Errors are RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code` and a
  `request_id` that matches the `X-Request-Id` response header.
- The tenant comes from the authenticated principal, never from the host or a header.

AssignTicketRequest.description:
`{ team_id?, agent_id? }`, at least one. Identifiers of another workspace fail validation
(422) because both models are tenant-scoped.
AssignTicketRequest.title: AssignTicketRequest

BulkAssignRequest.description:
`{ticket_ids, agent_id?, team_id?}` for a manual assignment of every ticket, or `{ticket_ids, auto: true}`
to run the assigner on each one.
BulkAssignRequest.title: BulkAssignRequest

BulkTransitionRequest.description: `{ticket_ids, status, comment?}`: the same transition for up to 100 tickets.
BulkTransitionRequest.title: BulkTransitionRequest

ContactRequest.description:
Create and update a contact. Email is unique per workspace ignoring case; the organisation must
belong to the same workspace (the tenant scope makes another workspace's id invisible).
ContactRequest.title: ContactRequest

DeliveryState.description: `pending`: queued for its next attempt. `failed`: the last attempt failed and a retry is scheduled at `next_attempt_at`. `succeeded` and `dead` are final (a manual retry reopens `failed`/`dead`).
DeliveryState.title: DeliveryState

ExportTicketsRequest.description:
`POST /v1/exports/tickets`: the ticket-list query of `GET /v1/tickets` (`filter[…]`, `search`,
`sort`) in the body, validated by the same rules, plus the format. Paging is ignored.

filter.description: Filter name => comma list, as `filter[…]` of `GET /v1/tickets`.

ExportTicketsRequest.title: ExportTicketsRequest

unread_notifications.description: Laravel's own relation on the user: Identity does not import the Notifications module.

variants_skipped.description: Why no variants will appear: `pixel_limit` or `failed`; null while pending or present.

ticket_id.description: Ticket notifications name the ticket; `export_ready` names the export and its file instead.

OrganizationTier.description: Customer tier of an organisation. Feeds the priority customer-tier factor and SLA policy selection; contacts without an organisation count as `standard` (docs/04-domain/contacts.md).
OrganizationTier.title: OrganizationTier

Priority.description: Ticket priority level. The score behind it comes from the PriorityStrategy (M2-04); a manual override wins over the computed level (docs/04-domain/tickets.md §Fields).
Priority.title: Priority

PriorityLevel.description: Ticket priority level; P1 is the most urgent.
PriorityLevel.title: PriorityLevel

type.description: URI of the error page on the docs host.

title.description: Short, stable summary of the error code.

detail.description: User-safe explanation; only for domain, validation, 403 and 419 errors.

request_id.description: Matches the X-Request-Id response header and the log lines.

meta.description: Domain-specific context, for example allowed transitions.

error.description: Why a failed export failed: too_large, quota_exceeded, forbidden or failed.

user_id.description: Create-only: UpdateAgentRequest prohibits it on PATCH.

StoreReportExportRequest.description:
`POST /v1/reports/{report}/exports`: the format and the report parameters as for a run
(`period` or `from`+`to`, `group`, `measures`, `filter`, `compare`), validated against the report.

parameters.description: As for `POST /v1/reports/{report}/run`; the report's defaults when omitted.

StoreReportExportRequest.title: StoreReportExportRequest

StoreTicketRequest.description:
`POST /v1/tickets`. The contact and category must belong to this workspace; the tenant scope
hides every other workspace's rows, so a foreign id fails exactly like an unknown one.
StoreTicketRequest.title: StoreTicketRequest

StoreWebhookRequest.description: `POST /v1/webhooks`. The URL is checked again by the SSRF guard (422 `webhook_url_rejected`).
StoreWebhookRequest.title: StoreWebhookRequest

settings_version.description: What every user needs from the workspace settings; the rest is behind settings.manage.

TicketStatus.description: Ticket lifecycle (docs/04-domain/tickets.md §State machine). The transition table lives here and nowhere else; every status change goes through `transitionTo()`.
TicketStatus.title: TicketStatus

TimerState.description: SLA timer states and the allowed transitions (docs/05-algorithms/sla-evaluation.md §States). Beyond the diagram: a paused timer can be met (the ticket is resolved straight from pending), and every unfinished timer can be cancelled (ticket closed as a duplicate, docs/04-domain/sla.md).
TimerState.title: TimerState

UpdateAgentRequest.description:
Separate PATCH schema so generated clients can send availability alone. `user_id` is
create-only: a profile never moves to another User.
UpdateAgentRequest.title: UpdateAgentRequest

items.description: At least one letter or digit, so every tag has a slug.

UpdateWebhookRequest.description: `PATCH /v1/webhooks/{webhook}`: any of name, URL and events. A changed URL passes the SSRF guard.
UpdateWebhookRequest.title: UpdateWebhookRequest

mime.description: Advisory: browsers send '' for types they do not know; the stored type comes from the extension.

purpose.description: Where the file starts: the Tickets folder, or Branding for a workspace logo (settings.manage).

WebhookEventType.description: The v1 event catalogue (docs/07-api/webhooks.md §Event catalogue). `ping` is the test event: it is sent by `POST /v1/webhooks/{webhook}/test` and cannot be subscribed to.
WebhookEventType.title: WebhookEventType
